messages:
natalie: starting a small embed quickstart that shows auth, one embedding call, and a deploy button. also migrating an old python snippet that used `client.embed` -> new `client.embed_vectors`. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/523

omar: thanks. two asks: 1) use REDWOOD_CLIENT_TOKEN env var (we decided to prefix client tokens) 2) include both sync and async py snippets so users on uvloop/async setups see examples

natalie: switched env var and added sync + async py. sync example:
```
import os
from redwood import Client
client = Client(os.environ['REDWOOD_CLIENT_TOKEN'])
resp = client.embed_vectors(model='embed-medium', input=['hello'])
print(resp[0]['vector'][:8])
```

async example:
```
import os
import asyncio
from redwood import AsyncClient
async def main():
  client = AsyncClient(os.environ['REDWOOD_CLIENT_TOKEN'])
  resp = await client.embed_vectors(model='embed-medium', input=['hello'])
  print(resp[0]['vector'][:8])
asyncio.run(main())
```
